articles.title: Gunfire damages home and vehicles in overnight shooting in Rexdale
articles.summary: Toronto police are investigating after gunfire struck a home and several parked vehicles in a residential neighbourhood in Rexdale early Tuesday morning. Officers were called to the area of Finch Avenue West and Humberline Drive at 3:05 a.m. following reports of a shooting. articles.title: A year after her 8-year-old son was shot in his bed, a mother continues to fight against gun violence
articles.summary: After her son was struck and killed by a stray bullet while in their North York apartment, Holly Roy says she continues to carry him with her as she advocates against gun violence.

articles.title: Motorcyclist seriously injured in Hwy. 401 crash in Mississauga
articles.summary: A motorcyclist has been rushed to hospital after a crash with a vehicle on Highway 401 in Mississauga. Ontario Provincial Police were called to the eastbound express lanes near Winston Churchill Boulevard around 4 p.m. Monday. articles.title: Parents frustrated with long wait times for Ontario autism program
articles.summary: A Vaughan mother is frustrated after waiting years to access the provincial autism program, with no clear end in sight. Amy Jones says her six-year-old son Elijah has autism and speech apraxia. “[It] is a neurological problem – it makes his brain and mouth not connect together,” she explains. articles.title: Luigi Mangione’s state murder trial postponed indefinitely amid double jeopardy fight
articles.summary: NEW YORK (AP) — Luigi Mangione’s state murder trial in the killing of UnitedHealthcare CEO Brian Thompson, which was slated to begin Sept. 8, has been postponed indefinitely as his lawyers seek to have the case thrown out on double jeopardy grounds following his guilty plea last week to federal charges.

articles.title: Beaver sculptures that welcomed FIFA fans in Toronto up for auction
articles.summary: Hand-painted beaver statues representing different countries in the FIFA World Cup that were sprawled across the eastern downtown neighbourhood of Old Town Toronto are now up for auction.

articles.title: Oil spill westbound on Highway 401 past Keele caused problems but all lanes open now: OPP
articles.summary: An oil spill in the westbound lanes of Highway 401 past Keele Street caused "major problems" earlier Monday but all lanes have reopened, police say.

articles.title: 5 charged, including 2 youths, in fatal double shooting on Brampton school grounds
articles.summary: A 21-year-old and two 17-year-olds from Brampton are facing two charges each of first-degree murder, after a shooting on school grounds in Brampton that took the lives of one man and one youth in April, Peel police say.

articles.title: Mike Layton files bid for his old Toronto council seat in Ward 11
articles.summary: Former city councillor Mike Layton registered to run again in University-Rosedale, following a four-year hiatus from city hall.

articles.title: Police investigating after man dies in motorcycle collision in Vaughan
articles.summary: York Regional Police are investigating after a man died in hospital following a collision involving a motorcycle in Vaughan late Sunday night.

articles.title: Possible human remains found in Scarborough commercial plaza, police say
articles.summary: Possible human remains were found in a Scarborough commercial plaza on Sunday, but police have not deemed the discovery a homicide.

articles.title: Zanzibar Tavern owner 'devastated' after Sunday morning fire
articles.summary: The owner of a historic adult entertainment business in downtown Toronto said he's devastated after a fire broke out at the commercial building Sunday morning.
